```yaml
name: Upgrade Check

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  upgrade-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install npm dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Prettier lint
        run: npm run lint:prettier

      - name: Run Style Contract lint
        run: npm run lint:style-contract

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install Python dependencies for Jupyter
        run: bin/setup-python-deps

      - name: Run shellcheck
        uses: luizm/action-sh-checker@883217215b11c1fabbf00eb1a9a041f62d74c744
        with:
          sh_checker_exclude: 'test/integration_*'
          sh_checker_shfmt_disable: false
          sh_checker_shellcheck_disable: false
          sh_checker_checkbashisms_enable: true
          sh_checker_comment: true
          sh_checker_only_diff: false

      - name: Run integration bootstrap compatibility test
        run: bash test/integration_bootstrap_compat.sh

      - name: Run integration distill test
        run: bash test/integration_distill.sh

      - name: Run integration upgrade CLI test
        run: bash test/integration_upgrade_cli.sh
```
